key.name: display-text
key.description: Text to display in the panel. Supports templates: %u (username), %U (display name), %h (hostname). Leave empty to use the display name.

key.name: position
key.description: Where to place the username in the top panel.

key.name: spacing-left
key.description: Extra spacing (in pixels) to the left of the username text.

key.name: spacing-right
key.description: Extra spacing (in pixels) to the right of the username text.

key.name: font-size
key.description: Font size in pixels. 0 uses the panel default.
